guide.title: How to choose the right musical
guide.intro: London’s West End is full of world-famous classics, hot new productions and more intimate theatre experiences. To make the most of your evening, it helps to think through a few basics before choosing your tickets.

step1.title: Start with the kind of experience you want
step1.text: Are you looking for a spectacular musical classic, a family-friendly show, a romantic night out or something modern and high-energy? Choosing by mood and genre can often help more than starting with the title alone.

step2.title: Check the date and venue
step2.text: On AJSEE, you can quickly see where each show is playing. The West End is a compact area, but the exact theatre location can also help you decide where to stay in London.

step3.title: Don’t leave tickets until the last minute
step3.text: For the most popular musicals, the best seats can disappear fast. If you’re travelling to London for a specific show, it’s worth sorting your tickets well in advance.

step4.title: Treat “from” prices as a useful starting point
step4.text: The indicative price on AJSEE helps you compare shows quickly. The exact price, current seat availability and fee details will be shown on the partner website before you buy.

final.title: Ready for a memorable West End night?
final.text: Choose your musical, continue to the TodayTix partner purchase page and secure tickets for an unforgettable London evening.
